OUR STORY SO FAR · A LITTLE MORE ABOUT US↓ SCROLL ↓

CHAPTER 1Childhood

A boy from Mumbai with big dreams and a girl from Bengaluru who always lit up every room. Different cities, different worlds, but somehow our stories were being written to meet one day and begin our lives together in the UK.

CHAPTER 2Our First Meet · York

Awkwardly clicking single photos, still new and nervous. We didn't stop clicking and talking until the very end, until the train left, and there she was, standing at the train door.

CHAPTER 3Our First Mini Trek · Peak District

Yellow and wine layers, fresh air, long walks and even longer conversations.

CHAPTER 4Weekend Getaways · Liverpool & Nottingham

Exploring new places, creating new memories, one weekend at a time.

CHAPTER 5Our Parents Meet

Two families, one big blessing.

CHAPTER 6Our Engagement

One knee, one ring, one very big yes.

CHAPTER 7Our First Trip Together · Wales

New places, new experiences, the same favourite person.
